title: Mode 2: DeterministicDriverSimulator, harness, 6 E2E scenarios
description:
Implement Mode 2 E2E core from docs/plans/15-mode2-e2e.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: §3 (test suite structure), §4 (6 scenarios), §7 (testing strategy — DeterministicDriverSimulator)

Key deliverables:
- DeterministicDriverSimulator: replays PTY output, OTEL spans, hook events from JSON-lines format. Supports real-time and fast-forward modes.
- TermmuxEnv harness: PTY launch/attach/detach/stop helpers
- SandboxEnv harness: session lifecycle + workspace fixtures
- ConfigInjection harness: credential/config directory setup
- Event normalization assertions: three-source fusion (OTEL > hooks > session-log), confidence flags
- 6 E2E scenario tests in e2etests/mode2/:
  - S1: Driver launch with credential injection
  - S2: Event normalization correctness (3-source fusion)
  - S3: Attach/detach lifecycle (no event loss)
  - S4: Pause/resume with idle snapshot
  - S5: Config directory persistence (path stability)
  - S6: Recovery from driver exit/crash
- Config path scheme: <sandbox-data-dir>/configs/<session-id>/ (outside ZFS, survives rollback)

AC: Driver launches with creds, events normalized from mixed sources, lifecycle controls work, idle snapshots captured, config paths stable across restart, crash recovery clean.
